name: pi-deepseek-startup
description: DeepSeek branded startup UI for Pi: whale splash screen, animated whale working indicator, and a matching DeepSeek theme. Bundles the startup-ui adapter, the DeepSeek page, and the DeepSeek theme in one installable package.
